key_requirements: GDPR applies: lawful basis, data subject rights, breach notification
deceased_data: Not covered: Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens states AVG does not apply directly to deceased persons' data (recital 27)
research_exemption: Special categories for public-interest research/statistics if consent impossible (art. 24 UAVG); rights 15,16,18 may be set aside (art. 44)
genetic_data: Prohibited in principle; allowed under same conditions as art. 24 or explicit legal basis (art. 28 UAVG)
notes: UAVG amended by Verzamelwet gegevensbescherming 2026; AP must publish fines; in force TBD
